description: Private marketplace for Kingdom Factor internal Claude Code skills.

plugins.name: kingdom-factor
plugins.description: Kingdom Factor internal skill suite: kf-prospecting (operator console for the n8n prospect pipeline: what is stuck, fix a row, start a run), kf-n8n-ops (keep the pipeline healthy; Tier 1 repairs the operator may do, Tier 2 changes go to Jordan), kf-marketing-manager (plain-English coach marketing reports), and kf-new-coach (onboard one coach across the GHL CRM, the Kingdom Factor platform and the Airtable Coaches index, as an audit she reads then an apply she confirms). Requires the shared KF n8n MCP + Airtable connectors; kf-marketing-manager uses the kingdom-factor app's hosted OAuth-protected remote MCP connector (added per-user in the Claude app).
